<div class="mw-parser-output">
<p>The <b>Fixture siege Z</b> was an invented siege of 1986, used only to exercise the refusals.</p>
<p>Following the Fixture event, 1900, the besiegers dug in and the town was quiet for a whole month.</p>
<p>The siege was caused by the Fixture event, 1969, which had emptied the garrison of its own cavalry.</p>
